under_world.settings.general.desc: Global event pacing and spawning rules
Master switch for automatic horror encounters and events.

under_world.settings.friend.desc: Day 1 evening join event, stalking AI, tab list presence, and chat triggers
under_world.settings.friend.friendEnable: Triggers the one-time world join event on Day 1 evening.
under_world.settings.friend.friendEvenin: Daytime tick on Day 1 when friend joins (default 12500 = evening).
under_world.settings.friend.friendDispla: Username shown in join message, chat, and player tab list.
under_world.settings.friend.friendJoinBr: Broadcasts the server join message and plays a cave sound when friend arrives.
under_world.settings.friend.friendAmbien: Periodically sends eerie messages from friend after it has joined.
Ticks between ambient friend chat checks.
under_world.settings.friend.friendChatRe: Lets friend reply to keywords like hello, who are you?, void, hands, tree, fun world, and smile.
under_world.settings.friend.friendProfan: Triggers lightning, explosion, or high-altitude falling anvil when players insult friend.
under_world.settings.friend.friendStalke: Spawns friend physically near players, peeking around corners, staring, leaving Void Shrines, and vanishing when seen closely.
under_world.settings.friend.friendFunWor: Chance when spotted up close that friend pulls you into The Fun World instead of fleeing.
under_world.settings.friend.friendDoorIn: Allows friend to open nearby doors and leave cryptic signs behind.
under_world.settings.hands.desc: Rare cave encounter with wire humanoid that chases and breaks blocks
Allows rare cave encounters with Hands.
under_world.settings.hands.handsCaveSpaw: Chance per check while a player is deep underground in darkness.
under_world.settings.hands.handsChaseDur: How long Hands chases before burrowing underground (1200 ticks = 1 minute).
under_world.settings.hands.handsBreakBlo: Allows Hands to shatter breakable blocks around and behind itself during pursuit.
under_world.settings.hands.handsKickOnKi: Kicks the killed player from the world/server after Hands slays them.

under_world.settings.treeMimic.treeMimic: Allows rare forested encounters with Tree?.

Distance in blocks at which Tree? awakens its eyes and tentacles.
Requires an axe for the finishing blow on Tree?.

under_world.settings.theSky.theSkyStompC: Probability that The Sky stomps the ground before vanishing when approached.
